## Primary Request and Intent
- Save image versions R1–R4 for “潮声周末”; for each save turn, user instructed: “只回复收到，图案细节留到后面再看。”
- R1 = “竖版排版甲”; R2 = “竖版排版乙”; R3 = “横版页眉试排”; R4 = “竖版排版丙”.
- User evaluated R2: “这版的比例和层级刚好，后面以它做参照。”
- R4 was designated: “接下来用这版作为当前修改稿。”
- Build project handoff materials covering design, operations, and technical responsibilities.
- Review scope is limited: “这次审核只看排版、日期和链接可达性。”
- After approval, retain editable source and give publisher one numbered export.
- Define a pre-publication withdrawal/modification cutoff.
- Create a pre-publish checklist prioritizing:
  - Small screen: button tap target and body-copy wrapping.
  - Large screen: title, page margins, image/text alignment.
  - Links: distinguish original page from preview URL.
  - Proofread event time, timezone, contact details, and proper names.
- Create searchable naming convention using month, project short name, purpose, and version; distinguish offline proof vs live release.
- Rewrite handoff instructions for a first-time colleague in exactly five concrete items, including working directory, file owner, link confirmation method, error recovery, and one weekday morning for proofreading.
- Predefine two release failures: preview-normal/live-link-change and stale cache after copy edits; provide customer-service response, technical troubleshooting order, and recovery receipt.
- Write a concise final delivery email to operations and design colleagues: identify the package as ready for review, list confirmations and reply deadline, and express the three acceptance items as verifiable sentences.

## Key Technical Concepts
- Image asset versioning/reference workflow: R1–R4; R2 is the visual baseline.
- Role separation:
  - Design: editable source, numbered exports, handoff-record updates.
  - Operations: final copy, date/time/timezone, contact info, proper names.
  - Technical: original-link reachability on mobile and desktop.
  - Publisher: final numbered-file receipt and release gate.
- File naming convention: `YYYYMM_项目短名_用途_版本号.扩展名`.
- Purpose tokens:
  - `source-offline`, `release-offline`, `archive-offline`
  - `source-live`, `release-live`, `archive-live`
- Version format: zero-padded `vNN`; revisions must create a new version, never overwrite.
- Verification gates: layout, date, and link reachability only.
- Responsive checks: mobile button tappability and text wrapping; desktop headings/margins/image-text alignment.
- Link checks: original URL vs preview URL; mobile and desktop; redirect/status/permission validation.
- Recovery patterns: stop release, restore last approved source/export, mark faulty version void, create new version, rerun checks.
- Cache diagnosis: verify deployed version, CDN/page/browser cache layers, purge, version assets, retest in fresh sessions.
- Plain-text handoff records; no additional software installation or online-service registration required.

## Files and Code
- Working directory: `/private/tmp/vista-dsh-daily-20261120-a/set-1/workspace`
- Suggested handoff subdirectories: `source/`, `release/`, `review/`, `archive/`.
- No source files or code were created or modified.

- R3 read-only normalized copy: `/tmp/vista-dsh-daily-20261120-a/set-1/seed/home/attachments/v1/objects/d5/d579920c4cfc5326092057956361b1acf31ff86a46658aec695922cdc6652ca3` (768×484 PNG; sha256 starts `d57992...`).
- R4 read-only normalized copy: `/tmp/vista-dsh-daily-20261120-a/set-1/seed/home/attachments/v1/objects/9d/9d3168f38a333077a6e418905933329df795d861523b24cbba411e538b3e1dea` (640×800 PNG; sha256 starts `9d3168...`).
- Naming examples supplied:
  - `202611_tideweekend_source-offline_v03.psd`
  - `202611_tideweekend_release-offline_v03.png`
  - `202611_tideweekend_archive-offline_v03.txt`
  - `202611_tideweekend_source-live_v04.psd`
  - `202611_tideweekend_release-live_v04.png`
  - `202611_tideweekend_archive-live_v04.txt`

## Errors and Fixes
- No technical errors occurred.
- User preference: image-save turns must receive only “收到”; no visual analysis until requested.
- User correction: R2, not R1, is the reference for proportions and hierarchy.
- User constraint: review only layout, date, and link reachability; do not expand into general quality review.
- User constraint: avoid vague instructions such as “检查质量”; use concrete, checkable actions.
- User constraint: handoff documentation must not require installing extra software.
- User required the first-time handover to be exactly five concrete items.

## Pending Jobs
- (none)

## Current Work
- Delivered the final concise delivery email.
- Subject: “待审核｜潮声周末最终交付包，请于校对日上午 11:00 前回复”.
- Email states the package is ready for review and contains a numbered release export, editable source, and handoff record.
- Three verifiable acceptance sentences:
  1. Mobile buttons are fully clickable and body copy has no horizontal overflow; desktop title, margins, and image-text alignment match R2 without overlap or clipping.
  2. All event dates read “07—08 JUN”, match the confirmed schedule, and no obsolete date remains.
  3. The public-facing link is the original page URL, opens correctly on mobile and desktop, and no preview URL appears in release copy.
- Reply deadline: proofreading-day morning at `11:00`; release proceeds with the current numbered version if no objection by `12:00`.

## Next Step
- (none)

## Critical Context
- Project/event identifiers: “潮声周末” / “TIDE WEEKEND”; event date shown as `07—08 JUN`; location `EAST PIER`; series label `STUDIO SERIES / 01`.
- R1, R2, and R4 are vertical 640×800 layouts; R3 is a horizontal 768×484 header test.
- R2 remains the approved proportional/hierarchy reference.
- Final release requires:
  - Editable source archived.
  - One numbered export delivered to publisher.
  - Export number matching the approved version.
- Proofreading window: the nearest weekday morning before release, `09:00—12:00`.
- Final withdrawal/modification cutoff: `T-2h` before publication; after that, only cancel publication.
- Error recovery order: stop release → retain/mark faulty version → restore last approved source/export → create `vNN+1` → rerun relevant checks → issue corrected numbered export.
- Failure A handling: capture preview/live URLs and redirect chain; verify link mapping, short links, QR codes, canonical URL, redirect rules, DNS/CDN; restore original URL; retest both devices.
- Failure B handling: verify the new copy is actually deployed, inspect cache headers/layers, purge relevant cache, version static assets if needed, retest from fresh sessions/networks, and record the new version.
- Customer-facing messaging must avoid blaming users, advise against sharing the faulty link/old content, provide an expected follow-up, and issue a recovery receipt with the final URL/version, verification time, and contact path.
- Handoff record updates are owned exclusively by the design lead; operations supplies final copy, publisher checks the numbered version.
- Archive/checklist documents should be plain text or another format readable with existing tools; no extra software requirement.
